name: Hotel Kailas Restaurant
why_it_matters: Hotel Kailas's in-house restaurant is the only proper mid-range dining within walking distance of the Ellora caves entrance (alternatives are the MTDC parking cafe or the ASI canteen inside the complex). Multi-cuisine + Maharashtrian + Chinese; thali + tandoori are the daily standards.
insider_tip: Lunch 12-3pm fills with day-trippers from Aurangabad; book ahead +91-2437-295811. Bar is open 12-3pm + 7-10pm. Service is slower than a city restaurant — allow 90 min for a sit-down lunch. Cards + UPI.
signature_address: NH-211, opposite Ellora caves entrance, Verul, Aurangabad District 431102

name: MTDC Ellora Restaurant
why_it_matters: MTDC Ellora-Aurangabad's in-house restaurant is the government-rate mid-range dining option opposite the caves — open to walk-in non-residents 12-3pm + 7-10pm. Veg + non-veg thali + tandoor + Maharashtrian standards.
insider_tip: Pre-cave breakfast 8-10am is the smartest order — the main kitchen opens at 12 for lunch. Cards + UPI. Closed Tuesdays (Ellora caves closure day).

name: Hotel Heritage Khuldabad
why_it_matters: Khuldabad-village multi-cuisine kitchen near the 14th-century Sufi-shrine cluster, 3km from Ellora — the post-Ellora + Sufi-pilgrim default. Mughlai biryani + Marathwadi thali. Aurangzeb's modest tomb is 200m away.
insider_tip: Lunch 1-3pm fills with Sufi-pilgrim coach traffic; arrive 12 or after 3pm. Mutton korma takes 25 min — order ahead. Cash + UPI.
signature_address: Khuldabad village, near Aurangzeb's tomb dargah, Aurangabad District 431101

name: Verul Village Dhaba (Grishneshwar)
why_it_matters: Verul village (Shivaji-ancestral, 1.5km from Ellora caves) has a cluster of small pure-veg dhabas on the Grishneshwar temple road serving Marathwadi-style unlimited thali at ₹120 — the post-Jyotirlinga-darshan default lunch. Bhakri-pithla-dal-rice + 2 vegetables, with refills. No-frills tin-plate seating.
insider_tip: Best paired with Grishneshwar Jyotirlinga visit; the dhaba cluster sits 200m before the temple gate. Cash only; UPI hit-or-miss. Open dawn-dusk.
signature_address: Verul village, Grishneshwar temple road, Aurangabad District 431102

name: ASI Canteen Ellora
area: Inside Ellora caves complex, near Cave 16 ticket counter
why_it_matters: ASI-run canteen inside the Ellora caves complex (near Cave 16 ticket counter) — the only food option without leaving the complex. Basic Maharashtrian snacks + chai + bottled water. Useful for the 4-6 hour cave-walk between Cave 1 (south) and Cave 34 (north).
insider_tip: Vada pav + chai is the standard combo at ₹60. Bottled water ₹20; carry an empty bottle for refills. Cash + UPI; no cards. Closed Tuesdays.
signature_address: Inside Ellora caves complex, near Cave 16 ticket counter, Aurangabad District 431102
